title: Bounded consortium v1 implemented payload contracts
$comment: Implemented bounded protocol payload contracts. Envelopes require current authenticated membership, exact boots/epoch/config, receiver leases and committed owner policy. Snapshot chunks carry at most2048 decoded bytes; manifests require exact identity/hash/length/revision and ordered ACKs. Plan/control types grant no raw CEC and are validated against persisted selectors and live bindings.

supported_tentacles.description: Configured hardware-profile capacity. This is not proof of physical adapter presence. Omitted legacy fields mean capacity1 and mask1.

configured_tentacles_mask.description: GPIO-assigned profile slots, not physical population. Bit n covers both sides of slot n; zero is a valid all-unassigned profile.
